title: Pike Place Market: Insider's Breakfast Tour - Gratuity Included!
includes: Intimate group size of 12 people or less
Skip-the-line access to iconic Market spots
Guide compensation is included in your ticket price; please do not bring a tip.
Personal connections with chefs, bakers, and producers
8+ tastings at a variety of Market vendors
Up close interaction with the famous fish-throwers at Pike Place Fish
Guided tour led by expert local storyteller
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Due to space constraints and uneven roads, strollers and wheelchairs are difficult to accommodate on the tour. Please plan that you will be walking about one mile and standing for the majority of the tour and possibly in direct sunlight or rain. We recommend comfortable footwear, appropriate clothing for the weather, and a bottle of water. Water will also be for sale at the meeting location
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Pike Place Market at 8 am is a different market. The vendors are unhurried, the crowds haven't arrived, and the people who've worked here for years have time to chat with you one on one.

This is the insider's version, a morning food tour led by professional storytellers with deep roots in the market community. You'll chat with a fishmonger who's spent years at Pike Place Market, taste two smoked salmons, and watch the legendary fish toss up close. You'll savor a fresh mini-donut straight off the Daily Dozen donut robot and experience the market the way locals do: early, unhurried, and real.

Three things we do that nobody else does:
- Guide Guarantee. Love your guide or your next tour is on us.
- Tips included. Gratuity is built into your ticket.
- Professional storytellers. Our guides aren't just enthusiastic locals. They're trained professionals who earn All-Star status annually through continual education, rigorous training, and 5-star review achievement.
